成功治疗犬耳部盘尾丝虫感染所致严重外耳炎一例

Successful Treatment of Onchocerca lupi Auricular Infestation Causing Severe Otitis Externa in a Dog.

中文摘要

我们报告了瑞士一例犬耳部盘尾丝虫（Onchocerca lupi）感染并引起严重单侧外耳炎的首次成功治疗病例。在取出线虫后，经分子分析确诊。联合治疗使病情在6周内完全缓解，突出表明O. lupi是伴肿块形成的慢性中耳炎/外耳炎的鉴别诊断之一。

英文摘要

We report the first successfully treated case of auricular Onchocerca lupi infection in a dog in Switzerland, causing severe unilateral otitis externa. Diagnosis was confirmed by molecular analysis after nematode extraction. Combined therapy led to complete remission within 6 weeks, highlighting O. lupi as a differential for chronic otitis with mass formation.
